exclusion_detail: Every target (4a-4j) is made in one step from ethionamide or prothionamide (purchased) and a coumarin intermediate 3a-3e whose preparation from salicylaldehydes 1a-1e and ethyl acetoacetate is only referred to ('reported in our earlier publication [9]'); no procedure, reagents or names for 3a-3e are given in this paper.

lead.label: 4j
lead.why: The abstract names no single best compound (4c-4e and 4h-4j tie at MIC 1.562 ug/ml); by the second rule the docking highlight is 4j, which 'displayed the highest negative DS with 6HEZ in addition to 4F4Q, and the second maximum negative DS with 4NCR'.

notes: The final step is explicit (intermediate 3 + ETH/PTH, equimolar, absolute EtOH, reflux 2 h; 4a procedure, 4b-4j 'in a similar manner') but all ten compounds depend on the unprocedured 3a-3e, so none qualifies. Lead choice under rule 2 is a judgement (docking was run for all ten compounds); the exclusion is the same for any of them.
